scenes.line2: How do slots and partitions help?
scenes.say: Want faster, cheaper BigQuery? How do slots and partitions help you optimize your queries?

scenes.label: Slots
scenes.sub: Units of compute for running SQL queries
scenes.say: BigQuery uses slots as units of compute. More slots mean faster queries.

rows.b: Split tables by day or month

scenes.say: Partition tables by date or integer columns. This way, queries only scan the data they need.

scenes.label: Clustering
scenes.sub: Organizes data by columns for fast filtering
scenes.say: Clustering organizes table data by columns, speeding up filters and sorts.
Pricing is simple: pay per terabyte scanned, or reserve slots for a flat monthly fee.

scenes.question: Partitioning always speeds up queries?
scenes.right: Only if queries filter on partitioned columns
scenes.say: Interview trap: Partitioning only helps if your queries filter on the partitioned columns.
